name: mujoco-mcp
description: General-purpose MuJoCo physics simulation via MCP — load models, run simulations, apply controls, analyze state, and automate workflows

tools.name: sim_status
tools.description: Health check: MuJoCo availability, depot, active jobs

tools.name: load_model
tools.description: Load MJCF/XML model into the depot from file or URL

tools.name: start_sim
tools.description: Start a simulation in a background process

tools.name: stop_sim
tools.description: Stop a running simulation by job_id

tools.name: get_state
tools.description: Get current simulation state (qpos, qvel, sensors)

tools.name: apply_control
tools.description: Apply actuator controls to a running sim

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List all loaded models in the depot

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: List active and completed simulation jobs

tools.name: export_frame
tools.description: Export most recent render frame as base64 PNG

tools.name: agentic_sim_workflow
tools.description: Autonomous multi-step simulation workflow via LLM

tools.name: natural_language_control
tools.description: Convert NL commands to actuator control values

tools.name: analyze_sim_logs
tools.description: Root-cause analysis from sim logs via LLM

tools.name: discover_model
tools.description: Search and download MJCF models from GitHub
